title: Semicon Series 3 | Inside TSMC’s “Baipu Plan” and the Hidden Agenda That Revealed It

What if TSMC could cut supplier feedback cycles from weeks to hours?

That is the idea behind its newly revealed “Baipu Plan.”

In northern Kaohsiung, TSMC plans to build a dedicated CoWoS validation line—not for mass production, but for equipment and materials suppliers to develop and test next-generation technologies alongside TSMC.

The urgency is clear. Nvidia and Google are pushing toward a new generation of AI accelerators every year, while advanced packaging is becoming increasingly complex.

TSMC’s answer is to stop having suppliers fight alone—and turn the entire advanced packaging supply chain into a team.

The plan surfaced through an unexpected “hidden agenda” after Semicon Taiwan’s scheduled sessions had ended.
